title: Operator decisions are rows with a recommendation, a default and a deadline
body:
Outcome: `krn decide add|list|close` stores decisions under `.krn/operator/`; the daily housekeeping run prints the open ones once.
Why: t-sd9a490 has waited since 2026-11-09 on a sentence in a task body.
Proof: a test adds a row, sees it listed with its deadline, and sees `close` record who decided.
Scope: a new `src/cli/decide.ts`, `src/cli/index.ts`, the housekeeping script, tests. Under 1 point.
Program: .krn/runs/krn-program-v2/06-program.md section 2, slice S4.
Operator order 2026-11-10: "Odpalaj" (program v2 planned on Fable).
